data.long_meaning: A Persian name derived from the Persian word 'parz', meaning 'lotus', and the Persian suffix '-een', meaning 'having the nature of'. The name Parzheen carries the meaning “Lotus” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Parzheen usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
